No internet connection Home > About > FAQ > Frequently Asked Questions General Conference Questions RSAC™ 2027 Questions General Questions General Conference Questions How do I apply to be a speaker at RSA Conference? Fill out an application during the designated Call for Speakers submission period which opens on September 15, 2026 for RSA Conference™ 2027. The application must contain your contact information and a detailed proposal of your session. Speakers are selected by the RSA Conference Program Committee, an independent panel of volunteer judges from the enterprise, government, academic, and vendor communities. How do I become an exhibitor at RSA Conference? RSA Conference offers vendors the unique opportunity to present their solutions to approximately 44,000 Conference attendees. To become an exhibitor or sponsor at the world’s leading cybersecurity event, contact a sales manager . What does “RSA” stand for in RSA Conference? RSA Conference began 36 years ago as a user conference for customers of RSA. RSA is an acronym made up of the first letters of the last names of the three co-founders of the company: Ron Rivest, Adi Shamir, and Leonard Adleman. How many years has RSA Conference been held? The first RSA Conference was held in 1991 and consisted of just one panel discussion. In the ensuing decades, RSAC has grown into a series of events held around the world, annually attracting over 44,000 attendees. What is RSA Conference? RSA Conference is the largest and most influential Conference in the cybersecurity industry. Today, under the expanded RSAC brand, the Conference is central to a larger mission that unites the cybersecurity community to create a secure and resilient digital world To learn more, visit www.RSAConference.com/usa . Who is RSAC? As the cybersecurity industry’s convening authority, RSAC brings together diverse minds to exchange perspectives, knowledge, and ideas. RSAC provides the world’s leading platform for uniting and advancing the cybersecurity community to create a safer society. RSAC is at the cutting edge of cybersecurity innovation and education. The company’s flagship event, RSA Conference, is the largest and most influential global gathering in cybersecurity. RSAC gives cybersecurity professionals a platform to connect and grow. To learn more, visit www.OneRSAC.com . What does the “C” stand for in RSAC? The “C” in RSAC represents community: cybersecurity for the community and by the community. In addition to community, it embodies collaboration, content, connection, culture, commerce, curriculum—and of course, Conference. Are sessions and Keynotes available after RSA Conference? RSA Conference makes select recordings of Keynotes and sessions available for viewing on demand approximately 30 days after the conclusion of Conference. View Library . How do I apply for Continuing Professional Education (CPE)/Continuing Education (CE) credits? We partner with leading educational organizations, such as IAPP, ISACA, ISC2 and more, to offer Continuing Education credits . Applying for CPE credits differs from organization to organization, so we recommend reading our web page and then connecting with the specific organizations for further details. What is RSAC LoyaltyPlus ? RSA Conference attendees who have purchased a Full Conference Pass or All Access Pass for four previous US RSA Conferences (does not have to be consecutive) qualify for the RSAC™ LoyaltyPlus program. As a member, you will receive special treatment and exciting benefits, including discounts on future select passes, access to the RSAC LoyaltyPlus Lounge, a collectible pin, and more. What forms of payment are accepted? We accept credit cards (American Express, VISA, Discover and MasterCard), checks and wire transfers. Purchase orders are not an accepted form of payment. RSA Conference Questions When is RSA Conference 2027? RSA Conference 2027 will take place –April 5 – 8 in San Francisco. Where is RSAC 2027? RSAC 2027 will take place at the Moscone Center and Yerba Buena Center for the Arts in San Francisco. What is the address of the Moscone Center? Physical RSA Conference events are held in San Francisco at the Moscone Center located at 747 Howard St. What do hotels cost and how close are they to the Moscone Center? There are several hotels with a range of rates that are within walking distance to the Moscone Center. For those who are not close enough to walk, there will be a shuttle service. See the Venue section of our website for details, available when registration opens in October. Is there a meeting space available at RSA Conference? There are various common areas within the Moscone Center that can be used for impromptu and informal meetings. Is the Moscone Center ADA compliant? It is the Moscone Center’s intention to provide all reasonable accommodations for people with disabilities to assist them in attending events held at the center. See the Venue section of our website for details, available after registration opens. Is there a lactation room or nursing mother’s room at the Moscone Center? Yes, there will be a nursing mother’s room at Moscone. Please reference the Expo Guide for location, or inquire at any of our Info Desks onsite. Are translation services available? RSA Conference is presented in English only. ASL and headphones for the hearing impaired are available and can be requested during the registration process. Open captions are included during RSAC™ Innovation Sandbox and all Keynotes. Closed captions are available on all on demand videos. What special dietary requirements are accommodated with the meals at RSA Conference? Gluten-free, Halal, Kosher, and vegetarian meal options are available and requests for these, along with any other special dietary requests can be made during the registration process. There are also many restaurants and eateries within easy walking distance of the Moscone Center that offer a wide variety of dining options. What seniority levels would benefit from RSA Conference? With hundreds of sessions, Keynotes, hands-on activities, and more, RSA Conference has something for everyone. A wide range of topics are covered, from cybersecurity fundamentals to high-level discussions for C-level professionals. How many people attend RSA Conference? In 2026, approximately 44,000 cybersecurity professionals from around the world gathered for RSA Conference. Read press releases . How many vendors are at RSA Conference? RSAC 2026 saw more than 600 exhibitors fill the North and South Expo, and Early Stage Expo, an innovation space dedicated to promoting up-and-comers in the industry. What is RSAC Early Stage Expo featuring Next Stage? RSAC™ Early Stage Expo featuring Next Stage, one of our innovation programs, is an exhibition space dedicated to promoting up-and-coming companies in the industry. Attendees can learn about their breakthrough products and solutions by visiting their booths or watching a short demo at the Early Stage Expo Briefing Center. What is RSAC Launch Pad? RSAC™ Launch Pad is designed to give companies with a breakthrough cybersecurity concept a platform to share their brilliant solutions. Three finalists compete in a Shark Tank®-style format to try to convince three cybersecurity venture capitalists that their idea has strong potential for success. All participants can expect to walk away with insights and tips that will help take their idea to the next level. What is RSAC College Day? RSAC™ College Day is a free program that gives college students the chance to explore career options, hear from the best in the field and network with leading companies. Students receive All Access Pass privileges on Thursday of Conference, plus attendance to some exclusive programs. General Questions Where do I find information on past events? Our library contains a comprehensive library of content that you can sort by content type, topic, Conference location, and year. How do I sign up for the newsletter? Use this page to sign up to receive our e-newsletter, exclusive content and specials offers on upcoming events. Where can I find the latest in industry news? An RSAC Membership will give you access to Daily Briefs so you can stay up to date on the latest trends and industry news, along with full access to the RSAC™ Library featuring, presentations, research, reports, webcasts, and much more. Does RSAC have a blog? You can find the most recent blog posts from RSAC here .
